decisions.decision: Checkpoint: victorvanhalst/smolvla_so101_cube; task = red cube pick (not Pen Transfer); camera mapping = wrist + AR0144 stereo split
decisions.rationale: Carried forward from the prior pause — see git history around commits d891f81/b4513dc for full rationale.

decisions.decision: Built control/detect_devices.py (Task 2, inserted mid-plan) to auto-detect follower/leader serial ports and wrist/stereo camera indices, writing control/device_map.json
decisions.rationale: Live testing this session found ports AND camera indices drift across sessions/replugs even for the same physical devices — the first e-stop test attempt silently used the MacBook's built-in FaceTime camera instead of a real camera because the old _probe_camera_indices() had no identity check. detect_devices.py excludes built-in cameras by system_profiler name and disambiguates the AR0144 (unique 2560x720 resolution) from the wrist camera (indistinguishable 1920x1080 from the built-in cam without name exclusion), falling back to an interactive cover-the-lens brightness check only when genuinely ambiguous.

decisions.decision: Fixed a real bug found live: robot_client.py's connect_bridge() only wired camera2/camera3 (AR0144 stereo split) into the bridge's observation dict — camera1 (wrist) was never populated, contradicting 11-04-SUMMARY.md's claim of 3 real camera views
decisions.rationale: Would have silently starved the VLA checkpoint of its wrist input during the live episode. Fixed by wiring camera1 via lerobot's own camera-config route.

decisions.decision: run_vla_episode.py's PORT/ROBOT_ID/--camera are now optional, defaulting to device_map.json when omitted; explicit CLI args still override
decisions.rationale: Removes the need to remember/re-type port and camera indices every session now that they're known to drift.
